from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashRecord(BaseModel):
    """Cash flow data for one company from its financial report."""
    company: str = Field(description="The company name as named in the report")
    cash_amount: float = Field(description="Amount of 收到其他与经营活动有关的现金")
    currency: str = Field(description="Currency unit (e.g., '元')")
    period: str = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2024年第一季度')")
    document_source: str = Field(description="Brief identifier of this document/report")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cash_records: list[CompanyCashRecord]
